biome_box.name: Biome Box (the biome in a transparent grid box)
biome_box.description: The biome in a transparent grid box. A glass box six metres square, the size of a shaft's opening, with the biome's own cell lines carried out onto the glass one metre apart; inside it biome_object, one ground from one seed, the same in every box down the tower. What differs from floor to floor is the stage: the biome may only be made of what the halls above have taught (the biome vocabulary), and phase says how far what arrives with this floor's sequence has come. A run of boxes down one shaft is one world growing as the visitor descends: on the L-system floors the tree and the creature arrive. The box closes the shaft and keeps a body out. It stays an empty grid with its seed until a body arrives on its floor, because the biome's builders take about a second.
biome_box.qfep_connection: The same ground is asked again on every floor what it is allowed to be: what a place can grow is a matter of what has been taught above it.

predicted_degeneracy.arithmetic: On a bench (seed 7) the ground, the pool, the web and the tree are the same at lsystems and at full; what full adds is the residents and the last connections, a dozen bodies of about 0.3 m. Twelve bodies of some 0.07 square metres each are 0.8 square metres of a picture that shows the 6 m box on about a third of the frame of 55: 0.8 / 55 = 1.5 %. randomness ~ lsystems differs by the whole tree, a crown about 2 m across.
